hypothesis: With direct confusable registry context held constant, normalized-exact retrieval accuracy may differ by the target record's model-token-relative position as requested context length increases. A sustained middle deficit relative to early and late conditions is behavioral evidence consistent with lost-in-the-middle, not a causal attention explanation.
null_result: Accuracy may not depend materially on evidence position in the tested range; stable or similarly degrading positions are valid evidence.
controlled_variables: same deterministic confusable registry-record generator v1
same record template for target and distractors
unique target and distractor entities/codes with no target leakage
fixed question template and answer complexity

case_generation.record_template: Registry entry: Project {entity} has access code {answer}.
case_generation.middle_compatibility: For a fixed pair count, middle uses the exact ECC-002 symmetric A-before/B-after record sequence. Tokenizer-specific terminal pair counts can differ across models and ECC-003 is not expected to be byte-identical to historical ECC-002 at every target.
case_generation.model_specific_budgeting: Each model receives a deterministic prefix of the same position-specific distractor sequence. Requested and actual counts are retained.

token_budget.position_spacing_note: Natural same-template records are discrete. The 512-token early condition uses the nearest valid token-position allocation; 160 tokens preserves it without changing semantic content or permitting truncation.

metrics.baseline: shortest selected context level separately for each requested evidence position
metrics.reliability_rule: Each ECC threshold is the last level in that position's contiguous tested prefix meeting the threshold; a later isolated recovery does not raise ECC.
metrics.right_censoring: If a threshold holds at the largest tested level, report it as a tested lower bound rather than a measured failure boundary.

failure_analysis.selected_distractor_relative_position: relative record ordinal within the deterministic context; target/distractor model-token positions remain separately retained where measured

success_criteria: model-token evidence-position measurement within frozen tolerance
raw per-case evidence and deterministic failure classifications retained
accuracy and descriptive runtime aggregated by context level and position
position gap and middle penalty derivable from results
position-specific ECC thresholds and right-censoring derived only with complete data
same definition reusable across both qualified models
